- SOC 2 evidence handoff (what we still need)
- DPA redlines and outstanding legal asks
- Pen test scope and preferred dates
- Audit logging access & retention questions

Current outstanding asks (owners & target):
- SOC 2 evidence: items 1–4 from matrix (owner: BrightPay security) — target by 2028-03-22
- DPA signature: BrightPay legal to review redlines (owner: Alex Turner) — target by 2028-03-24
- Pen test window: confirm preferred week (owner: Redwood security / BrightPay security) — propose 2028-04-04
- Audit log sample: provide one-week sample export (owner: BrightPay) — target by 2028-03-23

I’ve attached a lightweight SOC2_evidence_matrix.xlsx that maps what we need for the SOC 2 checklist, plus a draft pen-test-scope.pdf for your review.

Please reply with a single-line owner + date for each item above. If we can close these by the dates listed we’ll keep the original close target of 2028-04-15.

- SOC 2 evidence: Marissa (me) will collect delivered artifacts and validate against the matrix. If BrightPay provides the app config snapshots later, we’ll mark item 4 as pending and track separately.
- DPA redlines: Vanessa will own negotiation with your counsel and consolidate any last comments into the final redline doc.
- Pen test: Redwood recommends two vendors we’ve used for similar stacks — link in Drive. We’ll share vendor names and a short vendor questionnaire by EOD Mon (2028-03-19). Need BrightPay to confirm whether the test can run against a staging environment or requires production credentials.
- Audit logs: once exported, please provide the anonymized S3 link; Marissa will verify retention windows against our requirements.

Action items assigned (short):
1) BrightPay security: SOC2 items 1–3 (due 2028-03-21) — security@brightpay.com
2) BrightPay infra: app config snapshot ticket (due 2028-03-25) — Alex to open ticket
3) BrightPay legal: DPA review + signature (due 2028-03-26) — Alex
4) Redwood (Vanessa): consolidate DPA comments & return by 2028-03-22
5) Redwood (Marissa): vendor list + questionnaire (due 2028-03-19)
6) BrightPay: audit log S3 export (due 2028-03-23)

I attached an updated SOC2_evidence_matrix.xlsx (v2) with a few columns for status/notes. If BrightPay can tick off owners/dates in a reply, I’ll publish the MAP update and circulate to procurement.
